geometry.source: P2 mesh regions injector-zone/channel-straight/channel-divergent-exit of divergent-exit-stack.level-1; unchanged from v2

anomalous_collisions.alpha_note: model v2.1.0 Bohm-type anomalous transport: every electron has its velocity rotated about the local B by a uniform random angle (v_parallel and |v| unchanged, gyro-centre shifted - Brandt et al. 2016's event model) with probability 1 - exp(-alpha omega_ce dt) per step, omega_ce = e|B|/m_e at the particle; nu_an = 0.0625 omega_ce = 5.5e+08 s^-1 at 0.05 T, 3.2e+09 s^-1 at the channel max |B| 0.2914 T (nu_an dt = 0.0045); cross-field diffusion D_perp = (kT_e/eB) alpha/(1+alpha^2) = 0.0623 kT_e/eB (Green-Kubo, verified by tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_v210_anomalous_transport.py to 5 %). Elastic: no energy term, count tallied in cumulative.anomalous, axial momentum in pz_collisions; a separate exact-Poisson process outside the MCC null-collision budget (equivalent to O(nu_an dt x nu_mcc dt) ~ 1e-7). The alpha = 0 run is the ss-v4 plateau: without the block the configuration identity is byte-for-byte f10772b25b03 (test-pinned)

numerics.averaging_window_note: consecutive 400000-step (0.56 us at 1.4 ps) windows; the reported maps are the last completed window (or the current one if at least half full); the v2.0.3 gates read the same 400000-step window
numerics.checkpoint_note: checkpoint-latest.{json,npz} rewritten atomically every 40000 steps (56 ns); n_g and the atom ledgers are in the checkpoint arrays; series.jsonl / status.jsonl appended at every 200-step sync
numerics.dt_justification: 1.4 ps (v2: 1.5 ps): omega_pe dt at the v2 window peak 1.64e18 m^-3 is 0.101 (0.108 at 1.5 ps; gate 0.2); the attempt-8 resolution analysis asked dt <= 1.48 ps for omega_pe dt <= 0.16 (20 % under the gate) at the plume peak 3.7e18 - adopted here so the refinement also has time-step margin; electron Courant at 400 eV: 1.19e7 m/s x 1.4 ps = 16.6 um = 0.50 cells of 33.3 um (gate 1 cell); omega_ce dt at the channel max |B| 0.291 T: 0.072. Step-count conversions: 200-step series interval = 0.28 ns, 40000-step checkpoint = 56 ns, 400000-step window = 0.56 us, one ion transit (2.4 us) = 1 714 286 steps, 3 transits = 5 142 858 steps
numerics.frame_recorder_note: v2.0 frame recorder ON (28 ns frames): the alpha-series' ionisation / density / potential structure at the cusp planes against the v4 frames (0d228ad2), and a video per case; frames are diagnostics, not gates
numerics.neutral_update_note: the inventory is advanced at every series interval (= sync interval) with the ionisations tallied over that interval

peak_debye_gate.max_cells_per_debye_note: v2.0.3 window-mode gate (spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v2.0.json gates_v2_0.peak_debye_gate_v2_0_3): the gated statistic is max(dr, dz) / lambda_D at the densest node of the trailing 400000-step (0.56 us) interval average among nodes with mean occupancy >= 32 macro-electrons, with the window's moment T_e (the maps.npz construction). HARD pi (the Birdsall-Langdon CIC finite-grid-instability threshold; plume attempt 8 heated from ~3.2, the v2 base plateau sat at 3.17), fail-closed once the window is complete. SOFT 2.5 (20 % margin) is a plateau precondition (plateau.peak_debye_soft_ok), never a stop. Expected here: the v2 base peak 1.64e18 m^-3 / 7.39 eV gives lambda_D 15.8 um -> 33.3 um / 15.8 um = 2.11 (a 16 % margin to the soft level; the soft level is reached if the resolved peak densifies by 40 % at fixed T_e, e.g. 2.3e18 at 7.4 eV, or cools to 5.3 eV at 1.64e18); the hard level needs 3.6e18 at 7.4 eV. A plateau above 2.5 is recorded as 'resolution margin not met' (acceptance (a) fails, run continues to the budget) - a legitimate outcome, not a defect.
peak_debye_gate.min_accumulated_macro_particle_steps_at_: v2.0.6 (spec gates_v2_0.peak_debye_gate_accumulated_floor_v2_0_6): the gated node is the densest node whose ACCUMULATED macro-electron-steps over the 400 000-step window reach 64 000 (= 32 crossings x ~2000 steps), so axis columns that hold < 32 macro-electrons per step but are visited by many are gate-able (the v2.0.3 mean-occupancy floor of 32 made them invisible); on the v4 maps the gated statistic is unchanged (2.154 at the same node, resolved nodes 19 650 -> 42 130); the mean-occupancy floor stays recorded alongside
peak_debye_gate.min_macro_particles_at_peak_note: mean occupancy over the window; the v2 peak node (14, 286) held ~300 macro-electrons per step at W 6e4 (node volume 1.1e-11 m^3); at W 2.667e4 on the 33.3 um grid the corresponding node (r 0.7 mm: volume 2pi r dr dz = 4.9e-12 m^3) holds ~300 as well (same particles per cell); axis nodes (volume pi (dr/2)^2 dz / ... ~ 1e-14 m^3) stay below the floor

performance.moment_sample_interval_note: v2.0.5: electron window moments (T_e maps, peak-Debye T_e, sample counts) sampled every 5th accumulated step; physics bitwise, gated Delta/lambda_D moves by 1.7e-5 median vs K = 1 (8aca6c3a); enters config_sha256 by the v2.0.5 identity policy (K != 1 is a declared configuration); the alpha = 0 reference ran K = 1

numerics.poisson: device block-Thomas direct (exact to round-off, true-residual contract 1e-10 |rhs| verified at every host sync)
numerics.step_graph_note: v1.4 CUDA-graph step (bitwise-identical to the direct launches; tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_warp_parity.py)

operating_point.electron_injection_justification: kept from v1.2: v2 ignited from this injection at 1e20 and the v1.2 reference did not at 1.5e19 (beam mirrored back); attempt 1 at 5e19 with the 1e16 seed also did not ignite (91-96 % of the beam returned), so attempt 2 changes the seed, not the injection
operating_point.neutral_density_role: initial density AND MCC null-collision ceiling n_g0 (= Q_in / c, the zero-ionisation fixed point); the instantaneous n_g(t) is the inventory state

neutral_inventory.feed_justification: ATTEMPT 2: Q_in = c n_g0 with c = v_bar A_exit / 4 = 1.5547e-3 m^3/s (xenon at 300 K, v_bar = 220.0 m/s, A_exit = pi (3 mm)^2) and n_g0 = 5.5e19 m^-3: 8.55e16 atoms/s = 0.01864 mg/s. Expected fixed point where nu_iz tau = 1: n_g ~ 3.4e19 with S = Q_in - c n_g = 3.3e16 s^-1 (38 % utilisation) and n_eq = S / (V nu_iz) ~ 2.3e17 (0.58 n_max) if the plasma electrons carry the ionisation; lower if the beam does. Attempt 1 used n_g0 = 5e19 (Q_in = 7.77e16 = 0.01695 mg/s; fixed point at 3.4e19 would have been S = 2.5e16, n_eq ~ 1.8e17) and did not ignite - see 'attempts'
neutral_inventory.relaxation_justification: tau_g = 30 ns is artificial: << ion transit 2.4 us (n_g quasi-steady on plasma time scales), << physical effusion time V/c = 221 us, = 100 series intervals (averages the interval shot noise of S). Only the fixed point is physical; the artificial term has its own ledger so the atom balance closes to round-off

operating_point.seed_justification: ATTEMPT 2: the seed used by the v1 and v2 snapshots (5e16 m^-3, 5 eV; 286 k macro-particles per species at W = 6e4), which ignited at 1e20 with the beam fully absorbed from the first 100 ns (exit return 0.9 -> 0.26 mA, anode 3.2-3.6 mA, nu_iz 2.8-4.2e6 s^-1, T_e rising 8 -> 10 eV). Attempt 1 used 1e16 and the seed cooled (T_e 7.9 -> 5.0 eV) with nu_iz falling 1.16e6 -> 5.6e5 s^-1 and 91-96 % of the beam mirroring back; a 5x denser seed builds the plasma potential structure that traps the beam electrons (the beam-transmission jump between 5e19 and 1e20 was 23x in ionisations per injected electron, far more than the 2x in collisionality, pointing at the potential structure rather than the collision rate). The seed is a documented initial condition, not a sustained source: it is not replenished
operating_point.unchanged_note: EVERY operating-point key is bit-for-bit the v2 attempt-2 value (300 V, 0 V exit, n_g0 5.5e19, feed 8.551e16 /s, tau_g 30 ns, exit-plane injection 3 mA @ 2 eV, seed 5e16 m^-3 @ 5 eV, cold ions); the refinement changes the grid, the time step and the macro-weight only

preregistration.one_execution: one detached launch per case from the scheduler's worktree at the preregistration commit, one MPS slot each, in the declared priority order as slots free; a wall-budget stop may be resumed (new session, same identity, disclosed); no parameter is changed after the freeze
preregistration.preflight: preflight-<case>.json on the launch box (real P2 field on the 90 x 720 grid, mesh, factorisation, memory, ms/step at the seed load and at a synthetic ~4.5 M-particle load, GPU load before) - non-evidentiary; the budget is derived from it
preregistration.protocol: protocols/<case>.json is frozen at the preregistration commit (its sha256 is listed in the campaign protocol.json); summary.json records protocol_sha256 and git_head; run.py launch refuses a dirty worktree, a HEAD that is not the recorded preregistration commit, a sealed protocol that differs from its recomposition, or an existing execution lock
preregistration.shakedown: shakedown-<case>.json: a 100 000-step real-input run of one case (results-shakedown/, cadences shrunk, every gate live) through run -> finalize -> assess (case and series) on the launch box - non-evidentiary, not committed beyond the record

corrected_ledger.statement: the alpha = 0 reference FAILS its own acceptance (b) on the corrected ledger: +2.46 % of the electrode work in the trailing 400 000-step window at the stop (recorded -7.67 % before the v2.0.6 W fix; still rising at the plateau). It is the series' alpha = 0 point AS RECORDED, not a clean reference: every difference reported against it carries this caveat, and a case that passes (b) while the reference does not is itself evidence for the audit's expectation that the leak path bounds n_e (less finite-grid heating)

reference_run.particle_band_note: the 50 um convergence pair's relative bands (seed-b / W x 0.7; the v4 c-tolerances are 2x these): a shift smaller than the band is reported as 'inside the particle band' and does not count toward the trend verdict
reference_run.plateau: 3.033 transits (7.28 us, 5.2 M steps, 5.0 h), stop plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times; window [4.8 M, 5.2 M] steps; verdict vs the 50 um base: resolution_limited

simplifications: neutrals: 0-D quasi-steady inventory, uniform in space (no neutral flow field, no local depletion where the ionisation is, no wall accommodation); feed prescribed, exit-plane thermal effusion at 300 K; the transient toward the fixed point is artificial (tau_g = 30 ns vs the physical 221 us) and only the fixed point is physical
no ion-neutral collisions (elastic or charge exchange)
electron-neutral: isotropic elastic without the 2 m_e/M energy loss, one lumped 8.32 eV excitation, single ionisation with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy and isotropic emission
dielectric wall: perfectly absorbing with accumulated surface charge, zero field in the dielectric backing (perfect insulator), no secondary electron emission, no sputtering
exit plane: Dirichlet 0 V cathode/neutraliser reference; electrons injected there as a flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current
anode: perfectly absorbing conductor at fixed potential
cone wall represented as a one-cell stair-step of the plasma cell mask
prescribed static B from the P2 solution (no plasma-induced field); bilinear node interpolation of the C1 bicubic psi field
ions pushed every 8 steps with 8 dt (frozen in between; births added to the ion charge immediately)
electrostatic only, azimuthally symmetric: no azimuthal instabilities; the anomalous cross-field transport they would drive is IMPOSED as a declared Bohm-type closure (alpha), not computed
momentum-conserving bilinear scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger (with electrode work) residual is reported; a resume restarts the interval ledger

3 mA injection at 0.017 mg/s feed: a real CFT runs at 0.1-1 A and 0.1-1 mg/s; the self-consistent fixed point of the ionisation-depletion balance, not the absolute current or flow, is the object of this run

the Bohm closure is a constant alpha everywhere (the probability follows the local |B| only); a per-cell effective mobility from companion instability-plane runs is the declared follow-up (audit section 6 ii)
single seed per alpha: the shifts are judged against the recorded 50 um particle band, not a per-alpha replicate
the alpha = 0 reference (ss-v4) heats at +2.46 % of the electrode work on the corrected ledger: differences against it carry that caveat
preregistered closure-sensitivity study of a development model: no experimental validation, not a performance prediction

acceptance.a_plateau: stop_reason == plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times under the v4 rule (>= 3 transits = 5 142 858 steps, trailing-20 % drifts of I_d, N_e, n_g < 5 %, triad soft bounds, window-mode peak-Debye soft margin 2.5)
acceptance.b_residual_power: summary.grid_heating_triad.windowed_energy_residual_over_electrode_work (trailing 400 000-step ratio at the stop, v2.0.6 W-corrected ledger) < +0.02, one-sided; the alpha = 0 reference reads +0.0246 on the corrected ledger (FAIL) - a case that passes (b) is a cleaner plateau than the reference

cusp_electron_wall_current_a.reason: per-cusp wall electron loss rises as the closure feeds electrons into the loss cone region

cusp_sheath_drop_v.reason: cusp sheath drops fall as the hot tail is no longer mirror-trapped

discharge_current_a.reason: the closure opens a cross-field leak path to the anode through the cusp mirrors: more electron current reaches the anode per injected electron

exit_ion_beam_a.reason: follows S (weak: the beam fraction may rise as the anode ion loss changes)

ionization_rate_per_s.reason: electrons leak before ionising: the confinement time and the electron inventory fall

neutral_density_per_m3.reason: less ionisation depletes the inventory less (n_g fixed point rises)

peak_n_e_window_per_m3.reason: the density that builds up before the cusp mirrors is bounded by the leak

t_e_peak_window_ev.reason: the mirror-trapped hot tail leaks; less finite-grid heating at lower n_e

per_cusp.report: electron and ion wall current within +-1 mm of each cusp plane (maps.npz wall fluxes x wall area), the axis-to-wall potential drop and the near-wall T_e at the plane; reported per case beside the v4 values, signs judged by the hypotheses rows cusp_electron_wall_current_a / cusp_sheath_drop_v (they do not enter the monotone set: the v4 particle band for them is not measured)

c_series_trend.rule: for every quantity in hypotheses with a declared sign, the relative shift (case - reference) / |reference| is reported with the particle band; a shift counts as CONFIRMING when it has the declared sign AND exceeds the band, CONTRADICTING when it has the opposite sign AND exceeds the band, INSIDE THE BAND otherwise. The series is MONOTONE in a quantity when the values at alpha = 0, 1/64, 1/16, 0.345 are ordered in the declared direction (ties inside the band allowed)

d_verdict.note: the verdict is about the SIGN and monotonicity of the closure's effect on the recorded plateau; the magnitude at each alpha is the measurement. No alpha is 'chosen' by this campaign: alpha stays a declared closure parameter (audit section 6) until a companion r-theta / z-theta campaign supplies the mobility

per_case.no_plateau: NOT (a): budget / gate stop; trailing-window quantities reported, no trend contribution from this case
per_case.plateau_clean: (a) AND (b): a quotable plateau of the closure at this alpha
per_case.plateau_heating: (a) but NOT (b): the plateau heats above 2 % (like the alpha = 0 reference); the shifts are reported with the heating caveat

series.inconclusive: fewer than 3 points reached (a), or every shift of I_d and peak n_e is inside the particle band at every reached point
series.trend_confirmed: at least 3 of the 4 series points reached (a) (the reference counts) AND I_d and peak n_e are monotone in the declared direction AND no monotone quantity CONTRADICTS at any reached point
series.trend_not_confirmed: at least 3 points reached (a) AND (I_d or peak n_e is not monotone in the declared direction, OR some monotone quantity CONTRADICTS at a reached point) - a finding about the closure's sign, recorded as such

acceptance.declared: predeclared before the launch; evaluated by `run.py assess --case <case>` (per case) and `run.py assess --series` (the trend) against reference_run (the alpha = 0 ss-v4 plateau); verdicts recorded in results/<case>/assessment.json and results/series-assessment.json (results-only commits)

stopping_rule.fail_closed: runtime omega_pe dt gate (0.2), v2.0.6 window-mode peak-node Debye gate (accumulated-particle-step floor) (hard pi cells per lambda_D on the 400000-step interval-averaged peak, once the window is complete), grid-heating triad hard drift bounds (S, T_e,dense, omega_pe dt drifts >= 0.25 after one transit) and the v2.0.3 windowed residual-power bound on the v2.0.6 W-corrected ledger (trailing-400000-step ledger residual >= 5 % of the electrode work, one-sided, from the first complete window), one-cell Courant crossing, Poisson residual contract, neutral inventory exhaustion or ceiling violation: PIC2DStabilityError / triad stop ends the run with the artifacts written

grid_heating_triad.note: v1.4 triad drift members (soft 5 % = plateau precondition; hard 25 % after one transit) + v2.0.3 windowed residual-power hard gate (one-sided, 5 % of the electrode work over the trailing 400000 steps, from the first complete window); the cumulative ratio is recorded as the witness with its 10 % bound as a plateau precondition only. Calibration: the v2 base window ratios were -12.7 % (seed window) rising monotonically to -0.2 % at the plateau (max +0.37 %); seed-b -12.8 -> -1.5 %; w-0.7 -12.7 -> -4.2 %; attempt 8 crossed +5 % at ~3.1 us and reached +54.8 %; v2.0.6: the ledger's inelastic_loss_j carries W, so the windowed statistic IS the corrected one (the recorded ss-v4 series read -7.7 % where the corrected value was +2.46 %)

stopping_rule.ignition_check: the seed and injection are the ones that ignited v2 attempt 2 (and seed-b, w-0.7): S growing and N_e rising by ~1 us with n_g heading toward ~3e19; NO adjustment is allowed under this preregistration - a non-ignition is a recorded outcome of the refinement, not a reason to relaunch
stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of the elapsed simulated time for the discharge current, the plasma electron count AND the neutral density (linear fit, drift = slope x window / |mean|), evaluated at every checkpoint; may only be declared after >= 3 ion transit times (3 x 2.4 us = 7.2 us = 5 142 858 steps); additionally the grid-heating triad must be inside its soft bounds (plateau.triad_soft_ok) AND the window-mode peak-Debye soft margin must hold (plateau.peak_debye_soft_ok: trailing-window Delta/lambda_D at the peak <= 2.5) - the v2 base rule plus the v2.0.3 preconditions
stopping_rule.wall_budget_note: 10.3 h = 1.5 x 6.81 h (launch-box plateau-load preflight 4.77 ms/step with 3 other MPS clients x 5142858 steps to 3 transits), rounded up to 10 min; preflight-alpha-1over16.json
